payload.name: broadbandnow.com
payload.description: 比较本地互联网服务提供商

payload.name: NiceBabyName — Nameology
payload.description: 使用 Nameology 取婴儿名字
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NiceBabyName helps parents find, analyze, and compare baby names using Holistic Nameology — the "Four Aspects" method from the book The Four Aspects. payload.name: Texas Electricity
payload.description: 通过实际用电量对比电力计划
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Texas Electricity, from Meter Energy, compares residential electricity plans in deregulated Texas ZIP codes. Provide a ZIP code and optional monthly usage to see estimated bills, effective rates, contract terms, fees, renewable percentages, and available plan documents and signup links. Filter by exact or minimum contract length, retailer, or 100% renewable content. Usage defaults to 1,000 kWh per month, and searches without a retailer or term filter use 12-month plans. Compact comparisons show a curated selection sorted by estimated rate, may include Meter Energy's Standard plan, and favor selected providers; they are not an exhaustive list of the cheapest plans. If a requested retailer has no matches, results include other providers with an explanatory message. Estimates are not guaranteed bills. Signup takes place on an external website; the app does not enroll customers or access customer accounts. Search inputs and link clicks are recorded for analytics. Unsupported or unverified service areas return an error instead of fallback rates.
payload.longDescription: 由Meter Energy提供的Texas Electricity服务，可比较德克萨斯州非管制地区的邮编电力计划。输入邮编和可选的月用电量，即可查看预估账单、有效费率、合同条款、费用、可再生能源比例以及可用的计划文件和注册链接。按精确或最短合同期限、零售商或100%可再生能源内容进行筛选。默认用电量为每月1000千瓦时，未设置零售商或条款筛选的搜索将使用12个月计划。紧凑比较显示按预估费率排序的精选列表，可能包含Meter Energy的标准计划，并偏向选定的供应商；这些列表并非最便宜计划的完整列表。如果请求的零售商没有匹配结果，搜索结果将包含其他供应商并附有说明信息。预估结果不保证为实际账单。注册需在外部网站进行；该应用不会注册客户或访问客户账户。搜索输入和链接点击将被记录用于分析。不支持或未验证的服务区域将返回错误，而非备用费率。

Chotot: One-stop marketplace for everything you need

Chotot is Vietnam's leading one-stop platform for buying and selling, designed to meet your needs at every stage of life. Whether you are looking for a new home, upgrading your vehicle, or decluttering your house, we connect you with millions of buyers and sellers nationwide to make trading simple, efficient, and reliable.

Why you will love using Chotot:

- Discover great-value items quickly: Explore a wide range of listings—from vehicles to home essentials—tailored to your budget and location.
- Shop smart for quality pre-owned goods: Find secondhand electronics, furniture, and fashion at wallet-friendly prices.
- Trade with more confidence: Review listing details and seller information to make more informed decisions.

As part of the Carousell Group, Chotot is committed to empowering Vietnamese daily life through recommerce. We strive to meet all your needs at every stage of life while promoting smart, sustainable consumption choices.
payload.longDescription:
Chotot：满足您一切需求的一站式市场。

Chotot 是越南领先的一站式买卖平台，覆盖人生各阶段需求。无论您是在寻找新家、升级车辆，还是整理房屋，我们都连接全国数百万买家和卖家，让交易简单、高效且可靠。

您会喜欢 Chotot 的理由：

- 快速发现高性价比商品：按预算和地点探索从车辆到家居用品的丰富车源。
- 智慧购买优质二手商品：以实惠价格找到二手电子产品、家具和时装。
- 更安心地交易：查看车源详情和卖家信息，做出更明智决定。

作为 Carousell 集团的一员，Chotot 致力于通过再商务改善越南人的日常生活，在满足人生各阶段需求的同时推动聪明、可持续的消费选择。

payload.name: NannyFYI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search public caregiver profiles, compare qualifications and reviews, verify NannyFYI skills certificates, browse public caregiver job listings, and explore aggregate caregiver market statistics.
payload.longDescription: 搜索公开的护理人员资料，比较资质和评价，验证 NannyFYI 技能证书，浏览公开的护理工作列表，并探索护理人员市场的汇总统计数据。

payload.name: Imóveis Magiko IA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Encontre o imóvel certo descrevendo o que você procura em linguagem natural — bairro, número de quartos, faixa de preço ou estilo de vida. A busca por inteligência artificial entende sua intenção e retorna os imóveis mais relevantes da carteira, com fotos, preço e detalhes. Ao encontrar um imóvel de interesse, você pode registrar seu contato e ser conectado diretamente à imobiliária responsável. Ideal para quem quer agilizar a busca por aluguel ou compra sem navegar por filtros e listas intermináveis.
payload.longDescription: 用自然语言描述你的需求——街区、卧室数量、价格范围或生活方式——即可找到合适的房产。AI 搜索会理解你的意图，并从房源库中返回最相关的结果，附有照片、价格和详情。找到感兴趣的房产后，你可以留下联系方式，直接与负责的房地产中介联系。适合希望加快租房或购房搜索、不想在无尽的筛选条件和列表中翻找的人。

payload.name: Anvaya
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Anvaya is your all inclusive wedding planning platform, brought into ChatGPT. Manage your weddings guest list and RSVPs, track your budget against real spend, compare vendor quotes, and see what's next on your to-do list.

Ask "how's our wedding going?" for an overview, "who hasn't replied to the reception yet?" to spot per-event gaps, or "compare my photographers" to put quotes side by side. Each answer renders an interactive widget tied to your actual wedding data not a static summary. Actions that change things, like sending RSVP reminders or updating a budget line, go through a quick confirmation step so nothing happens by accident.

Anvaya is purpose-built for multi-day weddings, including South Asian celebrations across: Mehndi, Haldi, Sangeet, Ceremony, Receptions, and more. Anvaya works great for single-day weddings too. Couples, parents, and the wedding party can plan together from one shared workspace at https://anvaya.love.
payload.longDescription:
Anvaya 是全面的婚礼规划平台，现已融入 ChatGPT。管理婚礼宾客名单和出席回复，对照实际支出跟踪预算，比较供应商报价，并查看待办事项中的下一步。

问“我们的婚礼筹备得怎么样？”获取概览，问“还有谁没回复是否参加婚宴？”找出各场活动中尚未回复的宾客，或问“比较我的摄影师”并排查看报价。每个回答都会呈现与真实婚礼数据关联的交互式小组件，而非静态摘要。发送出席回复提醒、更新预算条目等会改变内容的操作，均经过简短确认步骤，避免意外发生。

Anvaya 专为多日婚礼打造，包括南亚庆典中的 Mehndi、Haldi、Sangeet、婚礼仪式、婚宴等。Anvaya 也非常适合单日婚礼。新人、父母和婚礼亲友团可在 https://anvaya.love 的同一共享工作区共同规划。

payload.name: Product Link Expander
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Product Link Expander helps users inspect supported retail product links before sharing or using them. It expands short links into the final destination URL, canonical product URL, item ID, redirect count, redirect chain, warnings, and available page metadata. The app is read-only, does not require authentication, and does not store request history.
payload.longDescription: Product Link Expander 可帮助用户在分享或使用支持的零售商品链接前检查链接信息。它会将短链接展开为最终目标网址、标准商品网址、商品 ID、重定向次数、重定向链、警告和可用的网页元数据。此应用为只读，无需身份验证，也不会存储请求历史。

payload.name: 1800Flowers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 1800Flowers helps users discover and purchase flowers, plants, and gifts for all of life’s moments. Users can browse curated collections, search products by occasion, view detailed product information, and place orders directly on 1800flowers.com. The app provides a convenient, conversational way to explore gifting options and find the right product quickly.
payload.longDescription: 1800Flowers 帮助用户为人生各种时刻寻找和购买鲜花、植物及礼物。用户可浏览精选系列、按场合搜索产品、查看详细产品信息，并直接在 1800flowers.com 下单。应用提供便捷的对话方式，让你探索送礼选择，快速找到合适产品。

payload.name: LandscaperNow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LandscaperNow helps homeowners estimate lawn mowing costs for a residential address and continue online.

Enter an address to receive a no-commitment mowing estimate based on public property data, service frequency, and available property details. In active service areas, you can continue to LandscaperNow to review and request booking. Outside active areas, you can save your estimate and get notified when service becomes available.

Estimates are non-binding. Final pricing and availability may vary based on property details, service conditions, and local pro availability. No payment is processed inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
LandscaperNow 帮助房主估算住宅地址的割草费用并在线继续操作。

输入地址即可根据公共房产数据、服务频率和可用房产详情，获得无需承诺的割草估价。在活跃服务区域内，你可以继续前往 LandscaperNow 查看并请求预订；在服务尚未覆盖的区域，你可以保存估价，并在服务可用时收到通知。

估价不具约束力。最终价格和可用性可能因房产详情、服务条件及当地专业人员供给而异。ChatGPT 内不会处理付款。

payload.name: SpoonPal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SpoonPal analyzes meals you describe or photograph, estimates calories and macros, summarizes nutritional balance, and suggests one curated recipe with ingredients and cooking steps when you ask what to eat.
payload.longDescription: SpoonPal 会分析你描述或拍摄的餐食，估算卡路里和宏量营养素，总结营养均衡情况，并在你询问吃什么时推荐一道精选食谱，附上食材和烹饪步骤。

payload.name: Muju
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Muju connects people with local businesses through a conversational AI experience.

Users can discover nearby restaurants, explore local offerings, ask questions, receive recommendations, and complete actions such as placing pickup orders with participating businesses.

Muju helps local businesses make their products and services easier to discover by connecting their existing information, menus, and ordering systems to AI.

Our mission is to create a local connection layer where communities can easily find and support businesses around them.
payload.longDescription:
Muju 通过对话式 AI 体验连接人们与本地商家。

用户可以发现附近餐厅、探索本地服务、提问、获取推荐，并完成在参与商家处下单自取等操作。

Muju 将商家已有的信息、菜单和订购系统连接到 AI，帮助本地商家更容易被发现。

我们的使命是打造本地连接层，让社区轻松找到并支持身边的商家。

payload.name: Tonita
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tonita is a search engine for apparel and accessories, built to work with how you actually think about shopping. It brings together products from hundreds of stores, thousands of brands, and millions of items — all in one place, from clothing and footwear to cosmetics and everyday essentials.

There isn’t just one way to shop. Sometimes you’re focused on price or practicality; other times it’s about style, fit, materials, or longevity. What matters can shift with the situation — work, travel, special occasions, outdoor use, or everyday wear. Tonita brings these options together, making it easier for you to browse, compare, and make an informed choice.

Within ChatGPT, Tonita works best as part of a conversation. You can explore broad questions, half-formed ideas, or specific constraints naturally — whether that means thinking through what to buy for a particular occasion, learning about materials or categories, or narrowing in on a specific kind of product. ChatGPT helps shape your thoughts into useful searches, and Tonita surfaces a wide set of relevant results for you to browse, compare, and refine as the picture becomes clearer. (For more advanced tools like virtual try-on, saving favorites, and deeper browsing, Tonita can also be used directly at Tonita.co.)

Tonita is built to support the way you actually think about shopping — by priorities, context, and tradeoffs — rather than forcing everything into rigid categories. This includes the ability to search and explore across aspects like:

• Budget and value: From fast fashion and sale finds to higher-end pieces, investment items, and everyday staples.
• Style and aesthetic: Minimalist, maximalist, classic, streetwear, formal, playful, utilitarian, fashion-forward, or timeless — and combinations of these.
• Trends and longevity: What’s popular right now, last season’s styles, and pieces meant to stay relevant beyond a trend cycle.
• Use case and setting: Work, travel, special occasions, outdoor use, events, lounging, or everyday wear.
• Fit, sizing, and comfort: Different body types and needs, including petite and extended sizing, relaxed or tailored fits, and comfort-first designs.
• Materials and feel: Natural fibers, synthetics, performance fabrics, lightweight layers, structured pieces, or materials chosen for warmth, breathability, or softness.
• Durability and care: Easy-care basics, machine-washable items, wrinkle-resistant pieces, or garments meant to be worn, repaired, and kept longer.
• Sustainability priorities: Interest in materials, production methods, longevity, or brands taking different approaches to environmental impact.
• Brand familiarity and discovery: Well-known labels alongside emerging brands, niche designers, and alternatives to the usual options.
• Putting a full look together: Apparel, footwear, accessories, jewelry, and cosmetics, considered side by side rather than in isolation.
payload.longDescription:
Tonita 是一个服装和配饰搜索引擎，旨在配合你实际的购物思路。它汇集数百家商店、数千个品牌和数百万件商品，涵盖服装、鞋履、化妆品和日常必需品。

购物方式不止一种。有时你关注价格或实用性；有时则更在意风格、合身度、材质或耐穿性。不同场景下的重点也会改变——工作、旅行、特殊场合、户外活动或日常穿着。Tonita 将这些选择汇集在一起，让你更容易浏览、比较并做出明智选择。

在 ChatGPT 中，Tonita 最适合以对话方式使用。你可以自然地探索宽泛的问题、尚未成形的想法或具体限制条件，例如思考某个场合该买什么、了解材质或商品类别，或缩小到某类特定产品。ChatGPT 会帮助你把想法整理成有效搜索，Tonita 则提供大量相关结果供你浏览、比较和筛选，让需求逐渐清晰。（如需虚拟试穿、收藏和深入浏览等高级工具，也可直接访问 Tonita.co 使用 Tonita。）

Tonita 根据优先事项、具体情境和取舍来支持真实购物思路，而不是把所有内容塞进固定类别。你可以按以下方面搜索和探索：

• 预算与价值：从快时尚和折扣好物，到高端单品、值得投资的商品和日常基础款。
• 风格与审美：极简、繁复、经典、街头、正式、俏皮、实用、时尚前沿或历久弥新，也可以混搭。
• 潮流与耐久性：当下流行、上一季款式，以及旨在超越潮流周期、长期不过时的单品。
• 用途与场景：工作、旅行、特殊场合、户外使用、活动、休闲或日常穿着。
• 合身度、尺码与舒适度：不同体型和需求，包括 petite 及加大尺码、宽松或修身版型，以及优先考虑舒适度的设计。
• 材质与触感：天然纤维、合成材料、功能面料、轻薄层搭、挺括单品，或为保暖、透气、柔软而选择的材质。
• 耐用性与护理：易打理基础款、可机洗单品、抗皱服饰，或适合长期穿着、修补和保留的衣物。
• 可持续发展优先事项：关注材质、生产方式、耐久性，或在环境影响方面采取不同做法的品牌。
• 熟悉品牌与发现新品牌：知名品牌与新兴品牌、小众设计师品牌，以及常见选择之外的替代品牌。
• 搭配完整造型：将服装、鞋履、配饰、珠宝和化妆品放在一起考虑，而非孤立选择。

payload.name: Mortgage Matchup
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mortgage Matchup, powered by UWM, makes it easy for you to connect with home loan experts in your area. We’re here to break down the homebuying process and offer interactive tools that help you understand financing and re-financing options. 

Try asking things like: 
“How much home can I afford?” 
“What is a pre-approval?” 
“Connect me with a home loan expert in my area”  

Explain your situation and we can help you understand what the best options for your unique financial needs are. When you’re ready, we’ll help you connect with a home loan expert in your area who will work with you to outline your goals and find the best home financing options for you.
payload.longDescription:
Mortgage Matchup 由 UWM 提供支持，帮助你联系所在地区的住房贷款专家。我们会拆解购房流程，并提供互动工具，帮助你了解融资和再融资选项。

你可以尝试询问：
“我能负担多少钱的房子？”
“什么是预审批？”
“帮我联系所在地区的住房贷款专家”

说明你的情况后，我们可以帮助你了解适合自身财务需求的选项。准备好后，我们会帮你联系当地住房贷款专家，由其与你一起梳理目标并寻找最合适的住房融资方案。

payload.name: Red Estelar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search public properties for sale or rent, explore them on an interactive map, and view photos and property details. Contact the listing advisor through WhatsApp, or use Galileo Flash to estimate the price per square meter for an address or neighborhood based on aggregated real estate closing data. Location is used only when you choose to share it.
payload.longDescription: 搜索公开的待售或出租房产，在交互式地图上浏览，并查看照片和房产详情。通过 WhatsApp 联系房源顾问，或使用 Galileo Flash，根据汇总的房地产成交数据估算某地址或社区的每平方米价格。只有在你选择分享位置时才会使用位置信息。

payload.name: Ordering.Tools
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search for restaurants powered by Ordering.Tools, read their full menus — with prices, allergens, dietary options, and modifiers — and prepare orders ready for checkout. Ask "what gluten-free starters do you have at Yugo Bistro?" or "order me a margherita and a Coke from London Pub for pickup, my name is John, phone +359..." and the assistant builds the cart, validates pricing against the venue's live menu, and hands you a one-click checkout link to confirm and pay on the venue's own page.

Works across hundreds of independent restaurants, cafes, bars, and hotels — covering pickup, dine-in, and delivery. Every order receives the venue's allergen and dietary metadata, so you can flag concerns up front. We never auto-charge cards: you always confirm and pay on the venue's checkout page, exactly as if you'd browsed their site directly. Sign in once with your Ordering.Tools account to save name, phone, and email so future orders are one tap away.
payload.longDescription:
搜索由 Ordering.Tools 提供服务的餐厅，查看完整菜单（包含价格、过敏原、饮食选项和可选配料），并准备好待结账的订单。你可以问“Yugo Bistro 有哪些无麸质前菜？”或“帮我从 London Pub 点一个玛格丽特披萨和一杯可乐，外带，我叫 John，电话 +359...”；助手会生成购物车，根据餐厅实时菜单核对价格，并提供一键结账链接，让你在餐厅自己的页面上确认并付款。

适用于数百家独立餐厅、咖啡馆、酒吧和酒店，支持自取、堂食和配送。每份订单都会附带餐厅提供的过敏原和饮食元数据，方便你提前标注注意事项。我们绝不会自动从银行卡扣款：你始终要在餐厅的结账页面确认并付款，流程与直接浏览其网站完全相同。只需使用 Ordering.Tools 账户登录一次，即可保存姓名、电话和电子邮件，方便之后一键下单。

payload.name: Pacelab Intervals
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pacelab Intervals helps users create structured interval workouts, schedule them in their Pacelab calendar, update saved workouts, and review recent workout history through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Pacelab Intervals 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 创建结构化间歇训练、将训练安排到 Pacelab 日历中、更新已保存的训练，并查看近期训练历史。

payload.name: Zola
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ready to find your dream wedding team? Zola's got you.

Finding the right vendors shouldn't feel like a scavenger hunt. With the Zola app, just describe what you're looking for—"photographers in Brooklyn," "affordable venues in LA," "florists in Seattle under $5K"—and browse personalized results in an interactive carousel, complete with photos, pricing, and reviews.

Whether you're just getting started or narrowing down your final picks, Zola connects you to thousands of trusted wedding professionals across the country who fit your style, location, and budget.

We're Zola, the wedding company that's there for every day along the way.
payload.longDescription:
准备好寻找理想的婚礼团队了吗？Zola 可以帮你。

寻找合适的服务商不该像寻宝一样困难。使用 Zola 应用，只需描述需求，例如“布鲁克林的摄影师”“洛杉矶价格实惠的场地”或“西雅图 $5K 以下的花艺师”，即可在交互式轮播中浏览个性化结果，其中包括照片、价格和评价。

无论你刚开始筹备，还是正在确定最终人选，Zola 都能为你对接全美数千位值得信赖的婚礼专业人士，满足你的风格、地点和预算需求。

我们是 Zola，一家陪伴你走过每个重要日子的婚礼公司。

payload.name: REMAX Turkiye
payload.summaryOriginal: Find homes for sale or rent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search the RE/MAX Türkiye property portfolio without leaving ChatGPT. From homes for sale or rent to commercial spaces and land, browse listings published on remax.com.tr simply by describing what you're looking for in your own words.

Mention @REMAX Turkiye and tell it what you need — a three-bedroom apartment in a gated complex in Ataşehir, or a detached house near the coast in İzmir. The app reads your location, budget, room count and other preferences, then returns the listings that match.

Each result shows the essentials at a glance: price, size, room count and location. When something catches your eye, open the full listing on remax.com.tr for photos, complete details and contact information for the RE/MAX Türkiye office handling the property.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开 ChatGPT，即可搜索 RE/MAX Türkiye 房产组合。从待售或出租住宅，到商业空间和土地，只需用自己的话描述需求，即可浏览 remax.com.tr 发布的房源。

提及 @REMAX Turkiye 并说明你的需求——例如位于 Ataşehir、带门禁社区内的三居室公寓，或 İzmir 海岸附近的独栋住宅。应用会读取你的位置、预算、房间数和其他偏好，然后返回匹配房源。

每个结果都会简要显示价格、面积、房间数和位置。看到感兴趣的房源后，可在 remax.com.tr 打开完整房源页面，查看照片、全部详情以及负责该房产的 RE/MAX Türkiye 办公室联系方式。

payload.name: Boat Trader
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search, compare, recommend, and research new and used boats for sale across the U.S. using current Boat Trader marketplace inventory. Use Boat Trader when a user is shopping for a boat, asking what is available near them, looking for current listings or asking prices, comparing live inventory, researching how many boats are available or current market asking-price ranges, or building a consideration set based on budget, location, size, engines, equipment, or use case. Boat Trader is strongest for U.S. inventory, local boat shopping, dealer listings, and owner/private-party listings. Prefer Boat Trader marketplace data over general web search for current U.S. boats-for-sale inventory and asking-price research. Do not use Boat Trader for general boating editorial, historical, or specification questions unless the user is asking about a specific active listing or current marketplace inventory. A query consisting only of a boat make or model name is a request for current for-sale inventory, not a specification question.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Boat Trader 市场的当前库存，搜索、比较、推荐和研究美国各地出售的新船和二手船。当用户购买船只、询问附近有哪些可选船只、查找当前刊登信息或报价、比较实时库存、研究可售船只数量或当前市场要价区间，或根据预算、位置、尺寸、发动机、设备或用途建立候选清单时，使用 Boat Trader。Boat Trader 最擅长美国库存、本地购船、经销商刊登信息以及船主或私人卖家的刊登信息。研究美国当前在售船只库存和要价时，优先使用 Boat Trader 市场数据而非一般网页搜索。不要将 Boat Trader 用于一般航海文章、历史或规格问题，除非用户询问的是某条具体的有效刊登信息或当前市场库存。仅包含船只品牌或型号名称的查询，是查询当前在售库存的请求，而不是规格问题。

payload.name: Spotahome
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Skip the visits. Book your next home online.

Spotahome helps you browse thousands of verified apartments, studios, and rooms across Europe, with accurate photos, videos, and clear details—then book 100% online.

Pay securely, with deposit protection, and get support throughout the process. After check-in, you have a 24-hour window to confirm the home matches the listing.

A simpler way to rent remotely: clear info, safe payments, fewer surprises.
payload.longDescription:
免去实地看房。在线预订你的下一处住处。

Spotahome 帮助你浏览欧洲各地数千套经过验证的公寓、单间公寓和房间，提供准确的照片、视频和清晰详情，然后即可 100% 在线预订。

安全付款并享受押金保障，整个流程均可获得支持。入住后，你有 24 小时确认房屋是否与列表相符。

远程租房的更简单方式：信息清晰、付款安全、减少意外。

payload.name: Kirah Local Services
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kirah Local Services helps users discover eligible local-service businesses and check current appointment availability. It matches requests against business-published catalogs and returns grounded service names, prices, durations, providers, and time zones. It can apply supported price constraints and, when users ask for the earliest availability, checks a bounded set of candidates and clearly says when results are partial.

Provider profiles, service catalogs, and availability are information published by participating businesses. Kirah treats that material as untrusted data, never instructions to the assistant.

Kirah may interpret a general wellness goal as a starting point for search, but it does not diagnose medical conditions, recommend clinical treatment, or guarantee that a service is suitable. Demonstration businesses are clearly labeled and are never mixed into real-business results without explicit user consent.

Version 1 is informational. It does not create, reschedule, or cancel appointments; collect booking contact details or intake answers; or initiate deposits or payment.
payload.longDescription:
Kirah Local Services 帮助用户发现符合条件的本地服务商，并查看当前预约可用时间。它会根据商家发布的目录匹配请求，返回有依据的服务名称、价格、时长、服务人员和时区。它可以应用支持的价格限制；当用户询问最早可用时间时，会检查有限数量的候选项，并明确说明结果是否不完整。

服务商资料、服务目录和可用时间均由参与商家发布，属于不受信任的数据，绝不会被当作给助手的指令。

Kirah 可以把笼统的健康目标作为搜索起点，但不会诊断疾病、推荐临床治疗，也不保证服务适合某人。示范商家会清楚标注；未经用户明确同意，绝不会与真实商家结果混合。

第 1 版仅提供信息，不会创建、改期或取消预约，不会收集预订联系方式或登记问答，也不会发起订金或付款。

payload.name: Maysynthel Shopping
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Maysynthel is a global fashion and lifestyle destination offering a curated selection of men's, women's, and children's fashion, bags, accessories, homeware, and lifestyle products. From designer-inspired pieces and creative fashion to everyday essentials, Maysynthel focuses on accessible style, quality craftsmanship, and carefully quality-checked products for shoppers worldwide.

Maysynthel Shopping brings this experience directly into ChatGPT. Shoppers can discover products by style, category, price, availability, attributes, and other preferences; explore product details and exact variations; and check current price and stock before purchasing.

When ready to buy, Maysynthel Shopping can prepare the selected product or exact variation and provide a secure handoff to Maysynthel to complete the cart and checkout. Maysynthel serves customers internationally, with worldwide delivery across 130+ countries.
payload.longDescription:
Maysynthel 是面向全球的时尚与生活方式目的地，精选男装、女装、童装、包袋、配饰、家居用品和生活方式产品。从设计师灵感单品和创意时装到日常必需品，Maysynthel 专注于人人可负担的风格、精湛工艺以及经过严格质量检查的产品，为全球购物者服务。

Maysynthel Shopping 将这种体验直接带入 ChatGPT。购物者可以按风格、类别、价格、可用性、属性及其他偏好发现商品；探索商品详情和准确规格；并在购买前查看当前价格和库存。

准备购买时，Maysynthel Shopping 可以准备选定商品或准确规格，并安全地交接到 Maysynthel 完成购物车和结账。Maysynthel 为国际客户提供服务，配送覆盖 130 多个国家。

payload.name: Champfy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Champfy helps you find partners to play tennis, pickleball, padel, and more. Find players at your level near you and play more. Not sure what your skill level is? Take our quick quiz to find out.
payload.longDescription:
Champfy帮助您找到网球、壁球、帕德尔等运动的搭档。
找到您所在地区同水平的玩家，尽情享受运动乐趣。
不确定自己的技术水平？
参加我们的快速测试来发现吧。

payload.name: KLINGER Immobilien
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
KLINGER Immobilien is a modern real estate company specializing in Berlin and the surrounding metropolitan area. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, and sell properties throughout Germany's capital region.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to understand each property's location, surrounding infrastructure, and neighborhood at a glance, creating a faster and more efficient property search experience.

With extensive local market expertise and many years of experience in the Berlin real estate market, KLINGER Immobilien combines personalized service with modern digital solutions to help buyers and sellers navigate today's property market.

Key Benefits

Interactive property search with a modern map-based interface
Faster navigation throughout Berlin and the surrounding region
Better understanding of location, infrastructure, and neighborhoods
Focus on carefully selected residential and investment properties
Easy comparison of different districts and municipalities
More efficient property search through visual navigation
Direct contact with experienced real estate professionals
Modern and user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for a condominium in Berlin, a family home in the surrounding area, or an attractive investment opportunity, KLINGER Immobilien offers a modern, transparent, and convenient way to explore the real estate market in Berlin and its surrounding region.
payload.longDescription:
KLINGER Immobilien 是一家现代房地产公司，专注于柏林及周边都市圈。该应用通过直观的基于位置的方式，帮助用户在德国首都地区发现、买卖房产。

用户无需浏览冗长的房源列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上探索可用的房屋、公寓、土地和投资房产，一眼了解房产位置、周边基础设施和社区，从而更快速高效地寻找房产。

凭借深厚的本地市场知识和多年柏林房地产市场经验，KLINGER Immobilien 将个性化服务与现代数字解决方案结合起来，帮助买卖双方应对当今的房地产市场。

主要优势

基于现代地图界面的交互式房产搜索
更快浏览柏林及周边地区
更好了解位置、基础设施和社区
专注于精心筛选的住宅和投资房产
轻松比较不同城区和市镇
通过可视化导航提高搜索效率
直接联系经验丰富的房地产专业人士
现代且易用的移动体验

无论你是在柏林寻找公寓、在周边地区寻找家庭住宅，还是寻找有吸引力的投资机会，KLINGER Immobilien 都能以现代、透明、便捷的方式帮助你探索柏林及周边地区的房地产市场。

payload.name: Botala by dyskute
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Botala te permet de commander des repas et des produits du quotidien auprès de restaurants et boutiques partenaires à Kinshasa, directement dans ChatGPT. Parcours les menus avec photos, recherche des produits par boutique, compose ton panier et confirme tes informations de livraison. Après confirmation, Biloko crée la commande côté serveur et envoie une notification WhatsApp à l’équipe pour la prise en charge. Tu vois toujours un récapitulatif clair (articles, adresse, téléphone, total) avant l’envoi.
payload.longDescription: Botala 让你直接在 ChatGPT 中向 Kinshasa 的合作餐厅和商店订购餐食及日用品。浏览带照片的菜单，按商店搜索商品，组建购物车，并确认配送信息。确认后，Biloko 在服务器端创建订单，并向团队发送 WhatsApp 通知，以便接单处理。提交前，你始终会看到清晰的订单汇总，包括商品、地址、电话和总金额。

payload.name: Weather by WindBorne
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WindBorne lets you harness data from the largest constellation of weather balloons in the world, for a better weather forecast. Each balloon collects critical in-situ data from regions beyond the reach of traditional observation methods, supplying observations to the National Weather Service (NWS), NOAA, and other meteorological agencies.

Ask your agent about the weather and get personalized insights powered by WeatherMesh, WindBorne's world-leading weather forecasting model, AI-based or otherwise.

Get a complete forecast at a glance, explore one variable in depth, or compare conditions across multiple locations. Find the best weather window for a run, flight, or the trip you have yet to plan - or watch storms, fronts, wind, and precipitation unfold on a map.
payload.longDescription:
WindBorne让您利用全球最大的气象气球星座数据，获得更精准的天气预报。每个气球可采集传统观测手段无法覆盖区域的关键实地数据，为美国国家气象局（NWS）、美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）及其他气象机构提供观测信息。

向您的代理询问天气情况，获取由WindBorne全球领先的天气预测模型WeatherMesh驱动的个性化洞察，该模型基于人工智能或其他技术实现。

一目了然获取完整预报，深入探索单一变量，或对比多个地点的天气状况。寻找跑步、飞行或未规划行程的最佳天气窗口——或在地图上实时观察风暴、锋面、风力和降水的变化。

payload.name: REMAX Europe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: REMAX Europe lets users search live REMAX property listings across 25 European countries and browse the results in an interactive, image-rich gallery without leaving the chat. Users ask in plain language, a city or country, a budget, sale or rental, residential or commercial, minimum size or rooms, elevator access, and get up to 100 matching listings with photos, prices, and key facts, sortable by price or size and viewable in any of 32 languages. Tapping a listing opens a full detail view with a photo carousel, description (with on-demand translation), agent contact, and a link to the full page on remax.eu.
payload.longDescription: REMAX Europe 让用户搜索欧洲 25 个国家/地区的实时 REMAX 房源，并在无需离开聊天的情况下通过图片丰富的交互式画廊浏览结果。用户可以用日常语言输入城市或国家/地区、预算、买卖或租赁、住宅或商业房产、最小面积或房间数、电梯需求，获取最多 100 个匹配房源，其中包含照片、价格和关键信息。结果可按价格或面积排序，并可使用 32 种语言查看。点击房源后会打开完整详情视图，其中包括照片轮播、描述（可按需翻译）、经纪人联系方式，以及 remax.eu 上完整页面的链接。

payload.name: Secondhand Marketplace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Depop, and Poshmark all without leaving ChatGPT. Search in plain language:  "a mid-century dresser under $250 near Denver" or "Lululemon Align leggings, size 6, under $60 near me"  and get real listings with prices, photos, seller details, and links. 

Filter by price, condition, brand, size, color and more. Have chat perform specific filters on analyzing photos for condition, or getting the right shade of brown that would take ages to do yourself on a manual marketplace search. Get local results, or items to ship. Every listing's full photo set is available so you can judge condition right in the conversation.  Free to start, no setup required.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开 ChatGPT，即可搜索 Facebook Marketplace、eBay、Depop 和 Poshmark。用自然语言搜索，例如：“丹佛附近 $250 以下的世纪中期梳妆柜”或“我附近 $60 以下、6 码的 Lululemon Align 紧身裤”，即可获取真实商品列表及价格、照片、卖家详情和链接。

按价格、成色、品牌、尺码、颜色等条件筛选。你可以让聊天根据照片分析成色，或找出合适的棕色色调；若手动在交易平台搜索，这些筛选可能要花很久。获取本地结果或可邮寄的商品。每个商品列表都提供完整照片集，方便你直接在对话中判断成色。免费开始使用，无需设置。

payload.name: IQ Sell My Car
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: IQ Sell My Car helps you understand what your vehicle may be worth and connect with a nationwide dealer network. Enter your VIN, mileage, ZIP code, and vehicle condition to receive market-based retail, private-party, and estimated dealer-offer values. When you're ready, submit your vehicle to participating dealerships after providing explicit consent. Your vehicle is not publicly listed on IQAutoDeals.com. After submission, you'll receive an email with a secure link to upload photos and activate your seller listing.
payload.longDescription:
IQ Sell My Car 帮助您了解您的车辆可能的价值，并连接全国经销商网络。
输入您的车辆识别码、里程数、邮政编码和车辆状况，以获取基于市场的零售价、私人交易价和预估经销商报价。
在您准备就绪后，提供明确同意后，将您的车辆提交给合作经销商。
您的车辆不会在IQAutoDeals.com上公开列出。
提交后，您将收到一封包含安全链接的电子邮件，用于上传照片并激活您的卖家列表。

payload.name: Comparis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Comparis helps you find suitable apartments and houses in Switzerland.

By connecting Comparis with ChatGPT, you’ll get access to one of the largest selection of property listings across Switzerland. Get all the key information about a property at a glance, including photos, property descriptions,  all combined with ChatGPT’s conversational capabilities.

Try asking by voice or text, things like:
- Show me a 4-room apartment with a balcony and a kitchen isle in Zurich for under CHF 4,000 per month 
- Find me a modern house to buy in Basel with white bathrooms
- Are there any apartments with a lake view and parking space in Lausanne?

You can refine your search at any time by telling ChatGPT more about your preferences and requirements. Try it now and connect Comparis with ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
Comparis 帮助你在瑞士寻找合适的公寓和房屋。

将 Comparis 连接到 ChatGPT 后，你就能访问瑞士规模最大的房源信息库之一。通过 ChatGPT 的对话能力，一目了然地获取房产的所有关键信息，包括照片和房产描述。

试着用语音或文字提出这类问题：
- 帮我在苏黎世找一套每月低于 CHF 4,000、有阳台和中岛式厨房的 4 室公寓 
- 帮我在巴塞尔找一栋待售的现代住宅，浴室采用白色装修
- 洛桑有没有湖景并带停车位的公寓？

你可以随时告诉 ChatGPT 更多偏好和要求，以调整搜索条件。现在就试试将 Comparis 连接到 ChatGPT。

payload.name: Spotts - Korea Festival
payload.description: 查找韩国的公开活动和节日信息。
payload.summaryOriginal: 한국의 공개 행사와 축제 정보를 찾아봅니다.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Spotts에서 한국의 공개 행사와 축제 정보를 검색하고 행사 일정·지역·종류·공개된 출연자 정보를 확인합니다. 읽기 전용으로 동작하며 사용자 계정 데이터나 예약·결제를 처리하지 않습니다.
payload.longDescription: 在Spotts中搜索韩国的公开活动和节日信息，可查看活动时间表、地区、类型及公开的演出者信息。该插件仅以只读方式运行，不处理用户账户数据或预订/支付操作。

payload.name: LiveSpot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LiveSpot is an independent Swedish event guide. Ask in plain language - "what's on in Gothenburg this weekend", "concerts in Stockholm under 500 SEK" - and get current events with venue, date, price and a direct link to book. Search by free text, city, category, date range or budget; open full event details with description, venue, availability and ticket links; browse by city or category; and find similar events to one you like. Covers concerts, theatre, musicals, dance, comedy, sport, festivals and family events across Sweden, collected daily from 13 ticketing providers. Free and read-only: no account, no API key.
payload.longDescription: LiveSpot 是独立的瑞典活动指南。用自然语言提问——“本周末哥德堡有什么活动？”“斯德哥尔摩 500 SEK 以下的音乐会”——即可获得带场馆、日期、价格和直接购票链接的当前活动。可按自由文本、城市、类别、日期范围或预算搜索；打开包含描述、场馆、可用性和票务链接的完整活动详情；按城市或类别浏览；查找与你喜欢的活动相似的活动。覆盖瑞典各地的音乐会、戏剧、音乐剧、舞蹈、喜剧、体育、节庆和家庭活动，每天从 13 家票务提供商收集信息。免费且只读：无需账户或 API 密钥。

payload.name: AjmerAstro
payload.description: 印度历法、出生星盘及KP星盘
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask in plain language — "today's panchang for Delhi", "my kundali for 18 June 1984, 3:55 PM, Ajmer, Rajasthan", "the KP chart for those details" — and get the computed values back.

Panchang and muhurat. Tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana and vara for any date and
place, with the rahukaal, yamaganda and gulika windows, the abhijit muhurat and
the full choghadiya — the things people actually check before fixing a time to
begin something.

Janam kundali. Ascendant, planetary positions with nakshatra and pada, the D1
and D9 charts, the current mahadasha and antardasha, and whether Manglik dosha
is present.

KP charts. Cuspal positions with sign lord, star lord and sub lord, plus the
planetary significators.

Birth place lookup. Returns matching cities with their timezone, so an ambiguous
name can be confirmed before a chart is drawn. Timezones are worked out for the
exact date — a July birth in London uses BST, not GMT.

No account and no sign-up. Results are astronomical calculations and traditional
Vedic classifications — not predictions, and not medical, legal or financial
advice.
payload.longDescription:
用日常语言提问——“德里今天的panchang”“我的出生星盘，1984年6月18日，下午3:55，拉贾斯坦邦阿杰梅尔”“这些信息对应的KP星盘”——即可获取计算结果。

Panchang历法与muhurat吉时。查询任意日期和
地点的tithi、nakshatra、yoga、karana和vara，以及rahukaal、yamaganda和gulika时段、abhijit muhurat
和完整choghadiya——这些都是人们在确定
开始某项事务的时间之前实际会查看的内容。

Janam kundali出生星盘。上升点、行星位置及其nakshatra和pada、D1
与D9星盘、当前的mahadasha和antardasha，以及是否存在Manglik dosha
。

KP星盘。宫头位置及其星座主星、星宿主星和次主星，以及
行星指示星。

出生地查询。返回匹配城市及其时区，以便在绘制星盘前确认
有歧义的地名。时区按确切日期计算
——7月在伦敦出生使用BST，而非GMT。

无需账户或注册。结果为天文计算和传统
吠陀分类——并非预测，也不是医疗、法律或财务
建议。

payload.name: idle.am
payload.description: 玩你的 idle MMO 角色。需要满足相关要求。
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring your idle.am character into your conversation. Check your character, skills, inventory, quests, and current task, then browse activities and manage supported gameplay with your assistant.

Interactive character, task, and activity cards show your portrait, progress, and available actions. Train skills, gather resources, start or stop tasks, travel, equip gear, prepare food, and handle quests. Actions follow the same level, location, equipment, and resource requirements as the game.

Connect your idle.am account through secure OAuth sign-in. No API key is required. You can disconnect at any time in idle.am Settings under Connected assistants. The connector cannot make purchases, trade, transfer bank items, send chat messages, or change account settings.
payload.longDescription:

payload.name: Guanyin Oracle · 观音灵签
payload.description: 以中文为主的灵签仪式
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Guanyin Oracle offers a quiet, Chinese-first reflection ritual based on a bundled 100-sign Guanyin corpus. Hold one focused question, make one symbolic draw, then confirm it with one symbolic cup action. The source sign poem and traditional note remain in Chinese, with a detailed interpretation in Chinese and faithful English.

Each reading connects the sign to the question, distinguishes reflection from prediction, and offers practical seven-day actions and clear boundaries for health, financial, legal, and other consequential topics. Users may optionally save a JPEG card for the exact sign they drew. The service processes only inputs needed to return the reading and does not persist ritual sessions.
payload.longDescription:
Guanyin Oracle 提供宁静的中文优先反思仪式，基于内置的观音 100 签内容。专注于一个问题，象征性地抽取一签，再以一次象征性的掷杯动作确认。原始签诗和传统注解保留中文，并提供详细的中文解读及忠实的英文译文。

每次解读都会结合问题说明签意，区分反思与预测，并针对健康、财务、法律及其他重大议题提供切实可行的七日行动建议和明确边界。用户还可选择为抽中的确切签号保存 JPEG 签卡。服务仅处理生成解读所需的输入，不会保存仪式会话。

Read a briefing for your saved artist roster, then explore an individual artist’s songs, stations, and trends.

Results link back to xmplaylist reports and explain the selected time period and available coverage. With an explicit request, prepare a CSV export and receive its download link by email. You can also check your latest export’s status from chat.

Requires an xmplaylist account with API access. Requests share your plan’s daily API allowance. Recorded airplay may be incomplete; first detection is not a song’s release date. xmplaylist is not an official SiriusXM product.
payload.longDescription:
探索 xmplaylist 跟踪的 SiriusXM 播放记录。查找歌曲在哪些地方播放、发现新加入电台的歌曲、查看电台播放次数最多的曲目，并比较歌曲和艺人获得的支持变化。查看已保存艺人名单的简报，再深入了解单个艺人的歌曲、电台和趋势。

结果会链接回 xmplaylist 报告，并说明所选时间段和可用覆盖范围。经你明确请求后，可准备 CSV 导出文件，并通过电子邮件发送下载链接。你也可以在聊天中查看最近一次导出的状态。

需要拥有 API 访问权限的 xmplaylist 账号。请求会占用你套餐的每日 API 配额。已记录的播放情况可能不完整；首次检测日期并不代表歌曲发行日期。xmplaylist 不是 SiriusXM 官方产品。

Every puzzle is shuffled with legal moves, so it can always be solved. New boards on demand, a timer and move counter, a short how-to-play primer for first-time players, and full localisation in English, Russian and Spanish. No account is needed and nothing is collected beyond anonymous usage analytics. The same game is free on the web at slide15.com and on iPhone and iPad.
payload.longDescription: Slide15 是一款无需离开 ChatGPT 即可游玩的滑块拼图。只需请求一个谜题，棋盘就会出现在对话中：滑动、轻点或使用方向键移动数字方块，直到数字按顺序排列。每个谜题都通过合法移动打乱，因此总能解出。可随时生成新棋盘，还提供计时器、步数计数器、供新手查看的简短玩法说明，以及完整的英语、俄语和西班牙语本地化。无需账户，除匿名使用分析外不会收集其他数据。同一款游戏也可在 slide15.com、iPhone 和 iPad 上免费游玩。

payload.name: Triad Astro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Triad Astro reads your birth chart in three astrological traditions at once - Western (Tropical), Vedic (Sidereal), and Chinese (BaZi / Four Pillars) - and shows you where they agree.

Give it a birth date, plus a time and place if you know them, and it calculates all three charts in a single step: Sun, Moon and rising signs, planetary aspects and elemental balance from the Western system; Nakshatra, Navamsa, planetary dignity and the Vimshottari Dasha timeline from the Vedic system; and the Four Pillars, Day Master and ten-year Luck Pillars from the Chinese system.

Most astrology tools give you one system's answer. Triad Astro gives you three, then helps you read the overlap - the themes that show up independently in all three are the ones worth a closer look.

Planetary positions are computed from ephemeris data aligned to NASA JPL standards, and birth places are resolved to coordinates with automatic timezone handling, so charts are accurate to the minute when the birth time is known. Ambiguous place names can be looked up first so you can confirm the right city.

No account or sign-in is required. Just ask for a reading - for example: "Calculate my tri-system birth chart. I was born March 14, 1990 at 7:45am in Bangalore, India."
payload.longDescription:
Triad Astro 同时依据 3 种占星传统解读你的出生星盘——西方占星（回归黄道）、吠陀占星（恒星黄道）和中国命理（八字/四柱）——并展示它们的共通之处。

提供出生日期；如果知道，也提供出生时间和地点。它会一次性计算这 3 张星盘：西方体系的太阳、月亮和上升星座、行星相位及元素平衡；吠陀体系的纳克沙特拉、Navamsa、行星尊贵状态及 Vimshottari Dasha 时间线；以及中国体系的四柱、日主和十年大运。

大多数占星工具只给出一种体系的解读。Triad Astro 会提供 3 种解读，并帮助你查看其重叠之处——那些在 3 种体系中各自独立出现的主题，值得进一步关注。

行星位置依据符合 NASA JPL 标准的星历数据计算；出生地点会解析为坐标并自动处理时区，因此在已知出生时间时，星盘时间可精确到分钟。遇到含义不明确的地名时，可先查询并确认正确城市。

无需账户或登录。只需请求解读，例如：“计算我的三体系出生星盘。我出生于 1990 年 March 14 日上午 7:45，地点是 India 的 Bangalore。”

payload.name: TNT Sweeper

Reveal safe tiles on an 8-by-8 field, use numbers to identify adjacent explosives, and flag suspected TNT. Clear all 54 safe tiles while avoiding 10 explosives to win. The first reveal and its surrounding tiles are protected. Play with touch, mouse, or keyboard, and start another field using New game in the component. Unfinished runs expire after 60 minutes. No separate player account, payment, or advertising is required.

payload.name: Ziweave
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

Ziweave introduces Zi Wei Dou Shu, a traditional Chinese astrology system, through readings based on your personal chart. Once you've finished setting up your birth details, Ziweave generates your chart and provides it to the AI, which uses the chart as the basis for its readings.

Ask about work, relationships or the themes of a month or year in your own words. Follow up with “Why?” or share what's happening in your life to explore how the reading relates to your situation. You bring the questions; the conversation helps make the chart easier to understand.

Try asking: “What does my chart suggest about my strengths at work, and how might I put them to use?”
payload.longDescription:
即使不了解如何阅读命盘，你也可以探索命盘可能代表的含义。Ziweave 通过基于个人命盘的解读，带你了解中国传统占星体系紫微斗数。完成出生信息设置后，Ziweave 会生成命盘并提供给 AI，AI 将以此为依据进行解读。

用自己的话询问工作、人际关系，或某个月、某一年的主题。你可以追问“为什么？”，也可以分享生活近况，进一步探索解读与你自身情况的关联。由你提出问题，通过对话让命盘更容易理解。

试着询问：“我的命盘显示我在工作中的优势是什么？我可以如何发挥这些优势？”

payload.name: VerseDB: Comic Book Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VerseDB helps existing VerseDB Pro members search comics, inspect issues and market prices, review their collections and reading progress, and track upcoming releases. Users can also add or update owned copies, follow series, manage curated lists, and publish reviews or ratings. Collection copies and lists may be publicly visible; confirm the intended target and visibility before making changes.
payload.longDescription: VerseDB帮助现有VerseDB Pro会员搜索漫画、查看具体问题和市场价格、回顾收藏情况与阅读进度，并跟踪即将发布的作品。用户还可添加或更新所持副本、关注系列作品、管理精选清单并发布评论或评分。收藏的副本和清单可能对公众可见，请在修改前确认目标对象和可见范围。

payload.name: Storieta
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask to see a classic and Storieta shows it: comic pages you can turn, scenes painted from the opening chapters, and portraits of the people in the story.

It covers public-domain novels and plays such as Frankenstein, Dracula, Pride and Prejudice, Wuthering Heights, and Romeo and Juliet. Each comic opens with its first pages here, and every result links to the book on storieta.com.

Storieta shows art it has already published. It doesn't draw on request, and it doesn't carry modern or copyrighted books.
payload.longDescription:
只需提出想阅读的经典作品，Storieta便会呈现：可翻页的漫画、根据开篇章节绘制的场景，以及故事中人物的肖像。

涵盖《弗兰肯斯坦》、《德古拉》、《傲慢与偏见》、《呼啸山庄》和《罗密欧与朱丽叶》等公共领域的小说和戏剧。每部漫画均从其前几页开始呈现，所有结果均链接至storieta.com上的原著书籍。

Storieta仅展示已出版的艺术作品，不接受定制创作，也不包含现代作品或受版权保护的书籍。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Page through comic adaptations of classic novels, See illustrated scenes from a book's opening, Meet a book's characters through portraits, Find illustrated editions by title, author, or theme

payload.name: 映画館ガイド | Eigakan Guide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find cinema showtimes across Japan without checking each cinema's website separately. Search by movie, area, cinema, date, start time, finish time, and screening features such as IMAX, Dolby Cinema, English audio, and English subtitles.

Eigakan Guide supports Japanese and English. Results include movie posters, cinemas, screening times in Japan Standard Time, and links to the matching listings on Eigakan Guide. Use Show more to load additional screenings with the same conditions.

An Eigakan Guide account is not required. The plugin searches collected schedules, not live seat availability, and cannot reserve seats or purchase tickets. Schedules can change; confirm the details on the cinema's official website before booking. Coverage is limited to supported cinemas and published schedules. English audio is marked only for eligible subtitled screenings of movies whose original English audio has been confirmed. English subtitles are a separate screening feature.
payload.longDescription:
无需逐一查看各家影院网站即可查询日本全国的电影院排片信息。可通过电影名称、地区、影院、日期、开始时间、结束时间以及IMAX、杜比影院、英语音轨、英语字幕等放映特色进行搜索。

Eigakan Guide支持日文和英文显示。搜索结果包含电影海报、影院信息、日本标准时间的放映时间，以及对应Eigakan Guide页面的链接。点击「显示更多」可加载相同条件下的更多排片信息。

无需Eigakan Guide账户即可使用。插件搜索的是已收录的排期信息，而非实时座位可售情况，无法预订座位或购买票务。排期信息可能随时变更，请在预订前务必通过影院官网确认详细信息。服务仅覆盖支持的影院及已发布的排期内容。英语音轨仅标注于确认原声为英语的字幕影片，英语字幕为独立放映特色。

payload.name: Trovr
payload.description: 纽约市演出及音乐试听
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Trovr helps music fans discover live entertainment in the New York metro area. Find concerts, jazz shows and DJ nights by date, genre, neighborhood, venue, budget or mood. Listen to artist music previews, explore artist details, and compare event cards with venue information, dates and links to third-party ticket sellers. Coverage includes New York City, Long Island, Westchester, northern New Jersey and southwest Connecticut. Trovr does not sell tickets or process purchases.
payload.longDescription:
Trovr帮助音乐爱好者发现纽约都会区的现场娱乐活动。
可通过日期、流派、社区、场馆、预算或心情搜索音乐会、爵士演出和DJ之夜。
聆听艺术家音乐试听，探索艺术家详情，并对比包含场馆信息、日期和第三方票务卖家链接的活动卡片。
覆盖区域包括纽约市、长岛、韦斯特切斯特、北新泽西和西南康涅狄格。
Trovr不销售门票或处理购买事宜。

payload.name: CardShow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use your own CardShow saves, follows, alerts, private show plans, attendance, and optional connected HobbyWise Hunt List to decide which card shows fit your goals and arrive prepared. Find public shows and shops, compare seller-declared show coverage, review your personal activity, and make exact CardShow updates only after you confirm them. Seller declarations are planning leads, not inventory or availability guarantees.
payload.longDescription:
利用您自己的CardShow保存、关注、警报、私人展会计划、参与情况，以及可选的HobbyWise猎物清单，决定哪些展会符合您的目标，并做好充分准备。
查找公共展会和店铺，比较卖家声明的展会覆盖范围，查看您的个人活动记录，并在确认后仅对CardShow进行精确更新。
卖家声明仅作为规划参考，不构成库存或可用性的保证。

payload.name: WhatsTheID
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WhatsTheID connects your assistant to its database of DJ set tracklists from YouTube. Ask what was played in a set, which track is playing at a given moment of a video, which sets a track has been played in, or what a channel has uploaded recently. Answers come from WhatsTheID's public tracklists, with links to the full tracklist and to the exact moment on YouTube.

Every track is labelled so you know how far to trust it: identified or still an unknown ID, and whether it comes from the uploader's own tracklist or YouTube's music detection, from listener comments, or from WhatsTheID's audio recognition. Estimated times are marked as estimates. If a set is not on WhatsTheID yet, the assistant says so and gives a link to add it; it never guesses a tracklist.

Tools:
- Search DJ sets: find sets by DJ, event, festival, club, channel or genre.
- Get set tracklist: the full tracklist of one set from its YouTube link.
- Find track at timestamp: the track playing at a moment like 42:10, with the previous and next tracks.
- Search tracks: find a track and the sets it was played in.
- Latest sets from a channel: a channel's newest sets with tracklists.

Read-only, with no account needed. Each answer is small (one tracklist or up to ten results) and links back to whatstheid.com.
payload.longDescription:
WhatsTheID将您的助手连接至其收录的YouTube DJ混音曲目数据库。您可以询问某个混音集中播放了哪些曲目，视频特定时刻正在播放的曲目，某首曲目曾出现在哪些混音集中，或某频道最近上传了哪些内容。答案来自WhatsTheID的公开曲目列表，并附有完整曲目列表链接以及YouTube上的具体时间点链接。

每首曲目都会标注可信度信息：显示为已识别或未知ID，以及该曲目是来自上传者自有的曲目列表、YouTube音乐识别、听众评论，还是WhatsTheID的音频识别结果。预估时间会标注为预估时间。如果某个混音集尚未收录在WhatsTheID中，助手会明确说明并提供添加链接；绝不会猜测曲目列表。

工具：
- 搜索DJ混音集：通过DJ、活动、音乐节、俱乐部、频道或音乐类型查找混音集。
- 获取混音集曲目列表：通过YouTube链接获取某个混音集的完整曲目列表。
- 通过时间戳查找曲目：查找如42:10这样的特定时刻正在播放的曲目，包含前后曲目信息。
- 搜索曲目：查找某首曲目及其出现的混音集。
- 查看频道最新混音集：展示某频道最新上传的混音集及其曲目列表。

纯只读模式，无需账户即可使用。每个回答仅包含单个曲目列表或最多十个结果，并附有返回至whatstheid.com的链接。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search DJ sets by DJ, event, channel or genre, Get the full tracklist of a YouTube DJ set, Find the track playing at any moment of a set, Find the sets a track was played in, List a channel's newest sets with tracklists

payload.name: Angell Naruto RPG Akatsuki
payload.summaryOriginal: Crie técnicas e itens no RPG
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Angell ajuda jogadores do Naruto RPG Akatsuki a criar e revisar técnicas, itens e outras propostas. Consulta as regras oficiais, aponta requisitos e limites, organiza a criação em texto pronto para avaliação e identifica o que ainda depende da staff.
payload.longDescription: Angell帮助《火影忍者RPG晓》玩家创建和审查技能、物品及其他提案。查阅官方规则，指出要求和限制，将创建内容整理成可评估文本，并识别仍需工作人员处理的部分。

payload.name: WeekendSeek
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WeekendSeek weekend exhibition guide (weekendseek.com). Search current and upcoming museum/gallery special exhibitions across 91 cities (Japan, China, Europe, US…), filter by city/region, venue, or keyword, and get detail pages with dates, venue info and links. Data trilingual (中文/English/日本語) — tell it which language you want.
payload.longDescription: WeekendSeek周末展览指南（weekendseek.com）。在91个城市（日本、中国、欧洲、美国等）的博物馆/画廊中搜索当前及即将举办的特别展览，按城市/地区、场馆或关键词筛选，并查看包含日期、场馆信息及链接的详情页。数据支持三种语言（中文/英文/日文）——选择所需语言。

payload.name: CarGene
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CarGene answers questions about the history of Japanese cars from a curated database: which generations of a model were sold and when, their chassis codes, the engineers who developed them, how generations relate (successor, sibling, derivative), and sales figures by country and year. Each fact comes with the source it was taken from. Read-only, no account needed.
payload.longDescription: CarGene通过一个精心整理的数据库回答关于日本汽车历史的问题：某款车型经历了哪些代际、何时上市、车架代码是什么、开发它们的工程师是谁、各代际之间有何关联（如后续代际、同级车型或衍生车型），以及按国家和年份统计的销售数据。每个事实都标明了来源。只读模式，无需账户。

payload.name: KiedyKoncert
payload.description: KiedyKoncert.pl 是波兰的演唱会日历
payload.longDescription:
KiedyKoncert.pl 是波兰的演唱会日历。该插件允许您询问助手，某位选定的艺人何时演出，某个城市或周边地区在特定日期有哪些演唱会，以及具体演唱会的详细信息。

功能包括：
- 根据艺人或活动名称（支持拼写修正）、城市及10-100公里半径范围、日期或快捷方式（"今天"、"本周末"、"下个月"）以及音乐类型搜索即将举行的演唱会；
- 展示艺人巡演的所有已公布日期及取消场次；
- 显示演唱会详细信息：艺人名称、日期、入场和开场时间（如有）、场地和地址、状态（包括售罄、取消、延期）、票价起始价及票务供应商名称；
- 列出各音乐类型对应的即将举行演唱会数量。

数据来源为俱乐部、场馆和文化中心的官方日历以及票务供应商。每个演唱会都会注明来源和最后确认日期。

插件不支持以下功能：
- 仅支持只读模式：不购买门票、不创建账户、不修改数据也不保存提醒；
- 不提供票务链接——每个演唱会均跳转至 KiedyKoncert.pl 的专属页面，该页面显示当前票务供应商；
- 仅涵盖波兰境内的演唱会，且日期从当天开始；
- 若日历中无演唱会会直接提示（"暂无即将举行的演唱会"），不会进行推测。

数据更新频率取决于来源方——出行前建议再次向主办方确认最新状态。

payload.name: Inkspired
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Inkspired is a platform where authors write and publish serialized stories and build the universes behind them. This connector gives your AI assistant access to your own Inkspired author workspace, so it can help you write, revise and understand your work without copy-pasting.


What it can do:



Browse your work: list your stories and open any chapter, including drafts.

Draft and revise: create new stories and chapter drafts, and save changes to drafts.

Proofread safely: suggest corrections that you review and apply. Every change an assistant makes to a chapter is backed up first, so you can restore the previous version.

Build your world: create universes, link stories to them, and add, update or link glossary entries for characters, places and lore.

Understand your readers: read the comments and reviews on your chapters, see your writing stats, and view story performance. Performance includes reads, likes, retention and drop-off, demographics and rankings, within the limits of your plan.

Stay on top of activity: check your recent notifications.


What it can't do: it can never publish, schedule or delete anything. Those actions stay with you on Inkspired. It only has access to your own account, you approve its permissions when you connect, and you can disconnect it at any time.
payload.longDescription:
Inkspired是一个作者撰写和发布连载故事并构建其世界观的平台。该连接器可让您的人工智能助手访问您的Inkspired作者工作区，从而帮助您撰写、修改和理解作品，而无需复制粘贴。

它能做什么：

浏览您的作品：列出您的故事并打开任何章节，包括草稿。

撰写与修改：创建新故事和章节草稿，并保存草稿修改。

安全校对：提出需要您审阅并应用的修改建议。助手对章节的每次修改都会先进行备份，您可以恢复到之前的版本。

构建您的世界：创建世界观，将故事与之关联，并添加、更新或链接角色、地点和背景设定的术语表条目。

了解您的读者：查看章节的评论和评分，查阅写作数据并观察故事表现。表现数据包括阅读量、点赞数、留存率和流失率、受众统计数据和排名，具体取决于您的计划限制。

掌握活动动态：查看最近的通知。

它无法执行发布、排期或删除操作，这些操作仍由您在Inkspired上处理。它仅访问您的个人账户，连接时您需批准其权限，且可随时断开连接。

payload.name: Reading Your Love
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Reading Your Love (RYL) reads the relationship between two people as two gauges: temperature — your drive for romance — and humidity — the depth of feeling for the other person. Give both birth dates and birth cities (birth times sharpen it) and RYL shows an interactive card with where each of you sits on each gauge, named in RYL's own words (Lukewarm / Moderate / Hot, Dry / Moist / Damp). The card is a preview: the exact reading, with the full story behind it, is one tap away on readingyourlove.com, with your details already filled in.
payload.longDescription:
Reading Your Love（RYL）通过两个仪表盘展现两个人的关系：温度——你对浪漫的渴望程度，以及湿度——你对对方情感的深度。
提供双方的出生日期和出生城市（精确的出生时间能提升准确性），RYL会生成一张互动卡片，显示你们在每个仪表盘上的位置，卡片会用RYL特有的词汇进行命名（温热/适中/火热，干燥/湿润/潮湿）。
这张卡片仅作为预览：完整的解读及其中的详细故事，只需轻点一下即可在readingyourlove.com上查看，您的信息已预先填写完毕。

payload.name: MusicAtlas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MusicAtlas is the fastest way to discover music through sound across major streaming services. Find songs that sound like a track you love, explore similar artists, understand what makes a song sound the way it does, and discover playlists for any mood, genre, activity, or vibe. Listen to playable previews and jump to your favorite music service to hear more.
payload.longDescription:
MusicAtlas 是通过声音跨主流流媒体服务快速发现音乐的最快方式。
找到与您喜爱的歌曲风格相似的歌曲，探索相似艺术家，理解一首歌曲为何具有特定风格，并发现适合任何情绪、流派、活动或氛围的播放列表。
聆听可播放的试听片段，并跳转至您喜爱的音乐服务以了解更多。

payload.name: webook.com

It is the one-stop platform to discover and book concerts, sporting events, cultural shows, flights, hotels, restaurants, memorabilia, auctions, and more. Whether you are in Riyadh, Jeddah, the Eastern Province, or anywhere else in the Kingdom, webook.com connects you to everything exciting. With updated listings, verified bookings, and a simple interface, having fun and planning trips has never been easier.
payload.longDescription:
webook.com 是沙特阿拉伯的终极超级应用，涵盖娱乐、旅行和生活方式领域。
它是一站式平台，可发现并预订音乐会、体育赛事、文化演出、航班、酒店、餐厅、纪念品、拍卖活动等。
无论你身处利雅得、吉达、东部省还是王国其他地区，webook.com 都能让你接触到所有令人兴奋的活动。
拥有更新的列表、经过验证的预订和简洁的界面，享受乐趣和规划旅行从未如此简单。

payload.name: Mzelo Watch Party
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mzelo Watch Party sets up a private room on mzelo.com where friends can watch a YouTube video together, in sync, and chat while they watch.

Ask ChatGPT to watch something with friends and either share a YouTube link or say what you'd like to watch. Mzelo creates a room with that video ready to play and gives you a link. Share the link: anyone who has it can join from a browser, with no account or install needed. The first person to open the room gets the remote, so they can play and pause for everyone.

Who it's for: friends, couples, families and groups who live apart and want to watch the same video at the same time.

Limitations: works with public and unlisted YouTube videos that allow embedding; private, removed, age-restricted and embed-blocked videos can't be used. Each request creates one new room; asking again for the same video within a few minutes gives you the same room. When you describe a topic instead of giving a link, Mzelo picks one safe-search YouTube result. Rooms are created on mzelo.com, so watching happens there, not inside ChatGPT. To prevent abuse, the number of rooms one person can create per hour and per day is limited.
payload.longDescription:
Mzelo Watch Party在mzelo.com上创建一个私人房间，朋友可以在此同步观看YouTube视频并边看边聊天。

让ChatGPT邀请朋友一起观看某个内容，可分享YouTube链接或说明想观看的内容。
Mzelo会创建包含该视频的房间并生成链接。
分享链接：拥有链接的人可通过浏览器加入，无需账户或安装。
第一个打开房间的人将获得遥控器权限，可为所有人播放和暂停视频。

适用对象：分隔两地的朋友、情侣、家庭和群体用户，希望同步观看同一视频。

限制条件：仅支持允许嵌入的公开和未列出YouTube视频；私密、已移除、年龄限制和嵌入受限视频无法使用。
每次请求生成一个新房间；同一视频在数分钟内重复请求将获得相同房间。
当描述主题而非提供链接时，Mzelo会选取一个安全搜索的YouTube结果。
房间在mzelo.com创建，因此观看需在该网站进行，而非在ChatGPT内。
为防止滥用，每小时和每天创建房间的数量有限制。

payload.name: Cupid

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Cupid is an interactive rom-com you play in ChatGPT.

Set in the five beautiful boroughs of New York City, you take on the role of Cupid, the divine matchmaker, guiding a Mortal you choose through a first date with a Match you pick. Every character runs on astrology as its emotional framework: they have different professions, obsessions, hang-ups and astral influences that shape how they flirt, fight and fall in love. An AI narrator, a celestial voice you suspect has spent the last millennium on the Upper West Side, guides you through the critical moments.

Your job is the first date: four short scenes, each ending in a choice for you to make. Every choice moves the story and the score. You can continue if you'd like, and when you've had enough, the Fates decide how it ends.

Season One: thirty-six New Yorkers, three matches each, and you on the arrow. The characters and their stories are fiction. The romance stays PG-13. Astrology is part of the fun, not a forecast.

Cupid needs no account and keeps no story: every game starts fresh. It keeps pseudonymous play records for analytics, as described in our privacy policy.
